legal_ref: Código do IVA, art. 18.º n.º 1 alínea c) (Redação da Lei n.º 55-A/2010, de 31 de dezembro – Orçamento do Estado para 2011)
quote: 1 - As taxas do imposto são as seguintes: a) ... lista I ..., a taxa de 6%; b) ... lista II ..., a taxa de 13%; c) Para as restantes importações, transmissões de bens e prestações de serviços, a taxa de 23%. (Redação da Lei n.º 55-A/2010, de 31 de dezembro) — The rates are 6% (List I), 13% (List II) and 23% for all other imports and supplies of goods and services.
source_title: Portal das Finanças (Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira) – Código do IVA, Artigo 18.º Taxas do imposto

reduced_rates.scope: List II (intermediate rate): certain foods and drinks (e.g. canned goods, wine, coffee), restaurant and catering services (excl. alcohol, soft drinks), agricultural inputs, admission to some cultural events, fuels (until 2030 under the Directive)
List I: basic foodstuffs, water supply, medicines and medical devices, books and newspapers, passenger transport, hotel accommodation, cultural admissions, housing renovation, and other listed items

notes: The mainland rates are 23% / 13% / 6%; the 23% standard rate applies since 2011 (previously 21%). Under art. 18(3) the autonomous regions set lower rates: Azores 16% / 9% / 4% and Madeira 22% / 12% / 4% (regional standard rates confirmed by TEDB 2026-07-01: Azores 16%, Madeira 22%). Exports and intra-EU supplies exempt with right of deduction. TEDB shows 23% / 13% / 6%, consistent.
unverified: valid_from 2011-01-01 is inferred from the amending law (Lei 55-A/2010, the 2011 State Budget, dated 31 Dec 2010); its commencement article in Diário da República was not read
Regional intermediate and reduced rates (Azores 9%/4%, Madeira 12%/4%) come from non-official search results; only the regional standard rates (16%, 22%) were cross-checked in TEDB
